about_the_game:
Information from the actual build: The game universe will expand in terms of gameplay, dialogue, and other aspects through updates. Any minor issues arising from the translation from Spanish to English will also be addressed. The Spanish game version will be coming soon. Some of the features mentioned in the description will be worked or improved by updates.

You got unchained with a purpose. Take control of the son of the Demiurge, and enter an interdimensional adventure where your choices matter, you will coexist with humans, and enemies will push you to the limit. Will you reach the power to interrupt the Festival of Abundance?

Demiurge Sacrifice is an atmospheric RPG-simulator that combines the brutal violence of dark fantasy with the tranquility of harvesting, gardening, socializing. All set in a supernatural medieval world and the next most important ritual ceremony on the continent.

The first episode "Tearful Procession" will show the beginning of your journey to meet the human world of Apostolorum Country's medieval society. You shall approach your time to study humans, meet the essence of their habits to adapt into their world, creating your farm and going to the religious procession that will change your eyes over the supernatural secrets of this society.

In the first part of your adventure, your research on humans led to something else. Your farm will make you know the secrets of the Church. Including doors between worlds. Places where the limit of the real, tangible and incorporeal becomes a diffuse and surreal element full of weird monsters influenced by cruel deities.

Features:

  • Complex Battles: The protagonist Kadyr, will face challenging enemies in varying quantities depending on the level. Supernatural monsters of religious-body horror.

  • Offering Corpses: You will be able to tear off limbs, bodies, or even souls! from your dead enemies and deliver them as a gift to your sleeping mother in an infinite void.

  • Chapters: The game will be divided into many episodes, each one with their own enemies, bosses and interactions that will change depending on progress.

  • Camouflage yourself powerfully: While you progress, you will be able to obtain costumes that will help you go unnoticed among the human world; and at the same time, empower yourself in combat.

  • Build Wisdom: Your actions in both worlds will help you build skills that you can improve and use to unlock more knowledge.

  • Get Links: On your adventure, you will meet other similar monsters as well as ordinary humans and future citizens of your world. Optionally, you can choose a woman as a partner.

  • Quest System:  Featuring varied quests that can be obtained either by the Demiurge and other places or NPC's.

  • Travel between worlds: The main character can interdimensionally travel between human world, Shapeless World as well as places defying these limits.

  • Immersive universe: Interactions with consequences and a fuctional time system that influences the characters.

Other aspects:

Demiurge Sacrifice stands out for its use of divided visual aesthetics depending on the game's world or setting.

The Shapeless Dimension's settings employ elements inspired by biomechanics and grotesque surrealism, with frequent use of distorted and some abstract forms, matching the dark alien theme. Added to all this is a hybrid artistic technique between 2D illustration, pixel art as well as a lot of literary lore.

Enjoy meticulously exploring this world, solving its puzzles, and traveling between dimensions. The Son of the Demiurge awaits to be unleashed for players who are fans of eccentric and challenging games!

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy violence, dark psychological themes, body horror and religious horror elements.

short_description: You got unchained. Between the Apostolorum Country and the Shapeless Dimension, your goal will be to travel between worlds and interrupt the Festival of Abundance. For this you should improve in combat and agriculture including managing a farm and exploring a religious medieval world.
